subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (Finovate Bank)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@finovate.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (Finovate Bank)

Hi Ana — great to meet today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum while you map stakeholders internally.

Call recap (high level):
- Primary use case: customer support triage + agent assist (reduce handle time, surface internal KB).
- Key success metrics: 30% reduction in escalations, 20% FTE-equivalent time savings in year 1.
- Technical constraints: data residency in us-east, prefer VPC/private deployment for PII, expected peak ~500 qps (burst).

Asks from your side:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement lead?
2) Who owns security/compliance reviews (SOC2 evidence, data flow diagrams, contact)?
3) Procurement timeline/target (PO, SOW, or contract cadence)?

What I attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft MAP), redwood-overview-deck.pdf (3-slide exec snapshot).

Suggested next steps:
- You confirm economic buyer + procurement/security contacts so we can tailor the MAP.
- I’ll prepare a 1-page ROI talk track and a 2-slide procurement packet for Sofia/Michael.
- Propose a 30-minute follow-up (tech + procurement) next week — Connor can join for technical Qs and Laura for procurement/terms.

Proposed agenda for follow-up (30 min):
1) Quick intro + success metrics (5 min)
2) Security & procurement Qs (10 min)
3) Technical fit & deployment options (10 min)
4) Next actions / MAP updates (5 min)

Would you be able to confirm names and an approximate procurement target date by end of week? Happy to update the MAP based on that.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx]
[Attachment: redwood-overview-deck.pdf]

From: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@finovate.com>

Hi Marissa — thanks for the great overview and for capturing the MAP. A few items from my side after chatting with internal team this morning: 

1) Economic buyer: Michael Ross (CFO) — michael.ross@finovate.com. He will want a concise ROI and TCO comparison.
2) Security/compliance: Amit Shah (Head of InfoSec) — amit.shah@finovate.com. He will request SOC2 evidence and a data flow diagram.
3) Procurement lead: Sofia Martinez (Vendor Mgmt) — sofia.martinez@finovate.com. Target timeline: procurement review week of Dec 20, aiming for contract execution by end of month if everything checks out.

I’ve attached our procurement_checklist.pdf for reference (lists required docs and timelines). Can you provide a short SOC2 summary and a one-page ROI we can share with Michael? Also — would be helpful to have a 2-slide packet that Sofia can share with procurement.

Confirming I’m happy to set up the follow-up; can we do something the week of Dec 7? Prefer mornings ET.

Thanks,
Ana
Ana Gomez
Director, Product Operations — Finovate Bank
[Attachment: procurement_checklist.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@finovate.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (Finovate Bank)

Perfect — thanks Ana. I’ll get those materials over to you before the end of day Friday. Quick notes below (for Michael + Sofia):

ROI summary (one-liner bullets for exec):
- Estimated run-rate savings: ~20% headcount equivalent on support team (projected $1.2M annual savings at current volumes).
- Payback: expected full payback within 9–12 months assuming 30% reduction in escalations and automated handling of common intents.
- Cost model: usage + reserved capacity option for steady-state predictability; we can model both in the MAP.

Procurement & security talk tracks (for Sofia/Amit):
- Procurement: Standard SOW + PO; we have one-page standard terms for enterprise deals and can accept amended clauses after mutual review.
- Security: We’ll provide SOC2 summary, dataflow diagram, KMS options, and redacted pen test summary. We support VPC/private deployment and bring-your-own-key options for keys.

Attachments I’m sending now: SOC2_summary.pdf, ROI_one-pager.pdf, updated mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MAP has suggested milestones and responsibilities).
\Proposed follow-up meeting: Tue Dec 7, 11:00am ET (30 min) — agenda as below. Connor will handle technical fit; Laura will run procurement items. If that works, can you invite Michael and Sofia or confirm I should loop them directly?
\Agenda (30 min):
- 5 min: Exec summary + ROI (me)
- 10 min: Security & procurement Qs (Laura + me)
- 10 min: Technical fit + deployment options (Connor)
- 5 min: Next steps / MAP updates
\Marking action items:
- Marissa: send SOC2 summary + ROI one-pager (in this thread).
- Connor: prepared 2-slide procurement packet (will send by Mon).
- Ana: confirm Michael/Sofia availability or invite.
\Thanks — will follow up with calendar invite once I have confirmation.
\Best,
Marissa
